scope: scripts/qualify_vci_mappings.py on a frozen Debug build of 133a513 (artifacts/vgd, git archive), 202/202 steps, in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1. Phase A as local.vci_mappings.20261028 (vci_mapping_add by export, vci_synchronize both directions, vci_mapping_remove). Phase C: a second VCI workspace with an SCL FC exported, committed and pushed with vci_push to a run-owned local bare remote (the Host's --git-remote); three rounds in which a plain-Git clone commits a value change and the FC's header family is edited in TIA; vci_fetch fast-forwards to the pinned remote commit; the fetched package is checked out into the workspace; vci_synchronize refuses VciConflict both ways and vci_package_compare reports divergentChange; vci_conflict_resolve resolves take=remote, take=native and take=merged (the native family merged into the remote document). Each resolution runs with checkpoint, PLC compile and save, an asserted Host-bound payload and preview, the worker's live export hash equal to the inspected contentSha256, CompareState Equal, exact package bytes, an exact state diff, and a refused second apply (RecoveryRequired). The native and merged results are committed on top of the fetched commit and pushed with compare-and-swap, and the bare remote's first-parent history and vci_history hold every commit. A fresh owned Portal reopen shows the identical state. Phase B restores one change per kind from its checkpoint, including a fourth take=remote resolution, each equal to the pre-change project state. Typed refusals change nothing.
limitations: One owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1, workspaces in the root workspace group and SCL FCs mapped by export; connect mode, library types, nested directories, companion files and global library policies are not exercised.
The Git remote is a run-owned local bare repository and the other engineer is plain Git in a runner-owned clone; network remotes and credentials are not exercised.
V21 has no project-neutral VCI export, so the native side of the three-way plan is the base package files with the object's inspected contentSha256.
Workspace files, including the checkout of each fetched revision, are written by the runner; change_restore never restores them, so restore equality covers the project state only.
V21 performed the directed Synchronize in both directions while ProjectObjectChanged and WorkspaceFileChanged were both set; this is one observation on one FC.
